correctness.rationale: A four-consecutive-vertex exclusion is proved directly; on the (3,2,1) spider arm constraints can individually exclude each necessary center colour, establishing a universal obstruction. The exact positive characterization through seven vertices is exhausted by two independent tree-generation/shattering methods agreeing on 1687 admissible marked pairs and the unique first exception. 32 explicit proper-colouring traces prove VC dimension at least 5 and the obstruction/necessary path test prove the matching upper bound. The finite computation is not extrapolated.

value.rationale: Exact first order and unique obstruction of the natural induced-star-forest heuristic for ternary colouring equality queries, and an exact VC dimension drop at the smallest branching tree, provide a motivated boundary result. The universal restriction lemma makes the structural obstruction apply to trees of any size. It is not a routine variant of the path classification because every selected induced component is itself a star and the nonshattering comes from competition at an unqueried degree-three center.
